name: Telekinetic Charge, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level bloodrager 3, magus 3, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as telekinetic charge except at the end of the charge, if the attack hits, all creatures, aside from yourself, within 10 feet of the target must make a Reflex save or take half the damage dealt to the initial target.
